infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Foliage Hunter listens so you can ask what leaf you found.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Foliage Hunter may use speech to understand your questions.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Foliage Hunter uses the camera so you can snap a leaf and get a name.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Foliage Hunter uses your photo library so you can identify a leaf without the camera.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Foliage Hunter can save a leaf find to your Photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Foliage Hunter to save leaf finds to your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Foliage Hunter to save leaf finds to your photo library.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Foliage Hunter to note where you found each leaf.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Foliage Hunter to snap leaves for identification.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow Foliage Hunter to choose a leaf photo for identification.
